common_checks.description: KYC must be valid before account, insurance, or investment recommendations are activated.
Nominee details should be checked for insurance and investment-related recommendations.
Joint account eligibility must be checked before recommending joint account products.
Required disclosures must be identified before customer engagement.
Recommended products must be suitable for the customer profile and detected life event.
Communication journeys must respect customer consent and communication preferences.
Human approval is required before recommendations are presented to the customer.

business_rules.description: Recommendations shall not be sent to customers without required human approval.
Compliance checks shall be completed before recommendations are activated.
KYC-related recommendations shall require valid and up-to-date KYC records.
Communication journeys shall respect customer consent and communication preferences.
If a recommendation fails compliance validation, it shall be marked as blocked or review required.
